# ThunderStudy

ThunderStudy is a free educational flashcard tool for students, run by Wondermayank. It turns topics, notes, PDFs, images, and YouTube captions into focused revision cards.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/) — Create flashcards from a topic or question.
- [PDF flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/pdf.html) — Extract study material from PDF files.
- [Image flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/img.html) — Read text from images with browser OCR.
- [YouTube flashcards](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/youtube.html) — Use a YouTube transcript as study material.
- [Preset decks](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/dack.html) — Browse exam-focused starter decks.
- [Saved decks](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/save.html) — Open and back up locally saved decks.
- [About](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/about.html) — Learn who runs the project and why.
- [FAQ](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/faq.html) — Read common questions and answers.
- [Changelog](https://flashcard.thunderstudy.indevs.in/new.html) — See recent additions and fixes.

Contact: contact@wondermayank.indevs.in
